source.note: Model ids, context windows, maximum outputs and USD-per-million-token prices are copied from the rows of that snapshot (catalog.provider / catalog.model name the row); tests/verify-live-runner.mjs compares every number with the snapshot. A value the snapshot lacks is null, with a note, and the runner refuses a provider whose input or output price is null. Prices are a dated public list, not a bill: check them before a paid run.

deepseek-flash.note: The plan says deepseek flash/chat: the snapshot lists no deepseek-chat under the deepseek provider, so the entry is deepseek-flash (also the Hub preset's default model). The snapshot has no cache-write price (null).

claude-haiku-5-5.note: A prompt of more than 100000 tokens is priced at the higher tier for the whole request; the runner gives the cost ledger the highest tier, so its count can only be too high, never too low.

openrouter-deepseek-v4-flash.note: OpenRouter routes to one of several upstream hosts; the listed price is OpenRouter's. The snapshot has no cache-write price (null).

ollama-local.note: A local Ollama server is not in the models.dev snapshot (only ollama-cloud is), so it has no context window and no price there: the model id is the Hub preset's default, the window depends on the server's num_ctx, and with an unknown price the runner refuses this entry. Whether a local model may be run at a price of 0 is the owner's decision.
